caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing male figure positioned on a rectangular wooden base. The figure is wearing a long, cylindrical robe that reaches the floor and is decorated with vertical black lines, black zigzag patterns near the base, and red wavy lines around the chest and lower part. The figure's right arm is bent at the elbow with a closed fist at chest height, and the left arm is also bent, with the hand in a gesture as if holding or presenting something. The hands and visible forearms are a pale beige color. The head features black hair and a short beard, both painted black, and the figure wears a black cap. The facial features include large, outlined eyes, defined eyebrows, a mustache, and a trimmed beard, all painted in black and brown shades. The figure's robe has the letters "IHS" inscribed on the chest in gray. The background is light beige and plain, with no additional objects or scenery visible.
title: Bulto (St. Ignatius)
